signals.text: 1 open PM role across 1 US office
1 new PM role posted this week

bullets: Own the product vision and roadmap for agentic automation, connecting customer needs to measurable business outcomes.
Define the controls, visibility, and evaluations that let customers trust autonomous decisions and involve a person when needed.
Work directly with customers to test the product in live operations, measure its impact, and drive adoption.
Partner with go-to-market teams on packaging, pricing, and launch, and define the metrics that connect automated work to customer value and revenue.
